title: BOX-PLACEMENT-STUCK-1 fix check (decision 72; bundle 20260929-205810). The CLIENT stands in its own fast-food shop (the reporter's 'Burgerking Foot', imported as fixture fx-boxgrab) and picks up a closed cardboard box that holds stock. The client first leaves the car the fixture loads it in and is asserted on foot inside its shop. Leg 3 runs first (premise): a normal pick-up + place still works. Leg 1 (F1): the game's own sale-to-zero refill runs on every item that stocks the box's goods while the box is held - the held box must keep its goods and stay alive, the skip is logged once, then Escape ends the move cleanly (a held item is never a restock SOURCE; it stays a TARGET). Leg 2 (F2): the held item is deleted mid-move through the game's own removal - the repair must end placement mode, release the PlacementMode navigation blocker and autosave, with no per-frame exception afterwards. Leg 4 (runs after leg 3, before leg 1): a newly placed single-product station is filled from storage right after placement (OnItemPlacementFinished runs while the item still counts as held). NO save.
